metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2006 · The Host
metas.description: A monster emerges from Seoul's Han River and begins attacking people. One victim's loving family does what it can to rescue her from its clutches.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1979 · Alien
metas.description: After investigating a mysterious transmission of unknown origin, the crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2014 · The Amazing Spider-Man 2
metas.description: When New York is put under siege by Oscorp, it is up to Spider-Man to save the city he swore to protect as well as his loved ones.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2007 · Spider-Man 3
metas.description: A strange black entity from another world bonds with Peter Parker and causes inner turmoil as he contends with new villains, temptations, and revenge.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2004 · Spider-Man 2
metas.description: Peter Parker is beset with troubles in his failing personal life as he battles a former brilliant scientist named Otto Octavius.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2002 · Spider-Man
metas.description: A shy teenager is bitten by a genetically modified spider and uses his new spider-like abilities to fight injustice as a masked superhero.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2017 · Spider-Man: Homecoming
metas.description: Peter Parker tries to stop Adrian 'The Vulture' Toomes from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2012 · The Amazing Spider-Man
metas.description: After Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider, he gains newfound, spider-like powers and ventures out to save the city from the machinations of a mysterious reptilian foe.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1995 · Richard III
metas.description: The classic Shakespearean play about the murderously scheming 15th-century king is reimagined in an alternative setting of 1930s England as clouds of fascism gather.
